aboutTeaser.label: About the Lodge
aboutTeaser.title: A Floating Lodge in the Heart of the Amazon
aboutTeaser.p1: Amazon Samaúma Lodge is a floating lodge located on the Mamori River, in the Careiro Castanho region, in the heart of the Amazon. Here, access is exclusively by boat — and that's already the start of the experience.
aboutTeaser.p2: With two floating lodges and cozy rooms, a restaurant serving regional Amazonian cuisine, and specialized guides, we offer the most authentic contact possible with the Amazon rainforest. Whether for sport fishing, exploring the local wildlife, or simply relaxing to the sound of the river — Samaúma is your destination.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Get answers about the lodge, access, tours, and reservations.
faq.q1: How does access to the lodge work?
faq.a1: Access is exclusively by boat, departing from Careiro Castanho — and that's already part of the experience! Upon confirming your reservation, we send all detailed access instructions via WhatsApp.
faq.q2: Is there cell signal or internet at the lodge?
faq.a2: The lodge uses Starlink internet, providing good Wi-Fi connectivity. However, cellular signals do not reach the location. We consider this an advantage: it's a real disconnection from the fast-paced city life.
faq.q3: Is sport fishing for any skill level?
faq.a3: Yes! We cater to both beginners and experienced anglers. Our owner also serves as a guide, adapting the experience to the guest's profile. Basic equipment is available.
faq.q4: Are meals included in the stay?
faq.a4: Please contact us via WhatsApp to confirm the details of the current package, including meals, transfers, and activities.
faq.q5: What is the best time to visit?
faq.a5: For sport fishing, the season is from September to January (dry period). For ecotourism, wildlife observation, and boat tours, the lodge welcomes visitors all year round.
faq.q6: Do you serve groups and families?
faq.a6: Yes! The lodge has capacity for groups and is excellent for families seeking an authentic and safe Amazon experience. Contact us to check availability and arrange a special package.

about.storyP1: Amazon Samaúma Lodge is a floating lodge located on the Mamori River, Careiro Castanho, in the heart of the Amazon. Here, access is exclusively by boat — and that's already the start of the experience.
about.storyP2: With two floating lodges and cozy rooms, a restaurant serving regional cuisine, and specialized guides, we offer the most authentic contact possible with the Amazon rainforest.
about.storyP3: Our philosophy is simple: real connections — with nature, with the riverside culture, and with yourself.
about.timelineDesc: From dream to reality — every step built with love for the Amazon.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.long: Every decision at Amazon Samaúma Lodge is guided by respect for the forest. We use energy consciously, reduce plastic use, and work in harmony with the nature that shelters us. Preserving the Amazon is our commitment to future generations.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.long: Every guest is welcomed with a genuine smile, fresh coffee, and the full attention of our team. Our hospitality is born from the riverside culture — warm, spontaneous, and true. We want you to feel at home in the heart of the Amazon.

safety.title: Safety
safety.long: All tours are led by local guides with extensive knowledge of the river and forest. We maintain quality safety equipment, life jackets, and first aid on all outings. Your family can relax with total peace of mind.

community.title: Community
community.long: We work with local residents, buy from riverside producers, and contribute to the prosperity of the Paraná do Mamori community. The tourism we practice respects the people who have guarded the forest for centuries.

fishing.title: Responsible Fishing
fishing.long: We practice Catch & Release on all fishing trips. Each peacock bass caught is carefully returned to the river, ensuring that species reproduce and that Mamori remains one of the best sport fishing destinations in the world.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.long: Amazon Samaúma Lodge is not a resort. It is a real dive into the Amazon — with its unique sounds, smells, tastes, and rhythms. The sunset over the Mamori, the pink dolphin appearing out of nowhere, the silence of the forest at night — all real. This authenticity is our greatest asset.

ecotourism.title: Trails, Adventures, and Ecotourism in the Amazon | Amazon Samaúma
ecotourism.description: Explore the Amazon jungle with guided trails, nocturnal safaris, dolphin and alligator watching, canoe trips, and sport fishing in Manaus (Careiro Castanho).
ecotourism.heroDesc: Guided adventures through the heart of the Amazon, for the whole family.
ecotourism.introTitle: The Amazon in its Purest State
ecotourism.introP1: Amazon Samaúma Lodge is embedded in one of the richest and most biodiverse ecosystems on the planet. Just a few meters from the lodge, the primary Amazon rainforest offers unique ecotourism experiences.
ecotourism.introP2: Pink river dolphins, alligators, capuchin monkeys, blue macaws, anacondas, and hundreds of bird species inhabit the region. The chance of sightings is high throughout the year.
ecotourism.toursDesc: Tap on any activity to view details, photo gallery, and make your reservation.
ecotourism.toursFootnote: ↓ All tours are guided by local experts
ecotourism.faunaDesc: The Paraná do Mamori and its surroundings host one of the largest concentrations of species in South America. In this region, you can spot:
ecotourism.galleryDesc: Some of the incredible species captured by the lenses of our visitors and guides.

toursList.title: Amazonian Safari
toursList.subtitle: Flora & Fauna
toursList.desc: Embark on a guided expedition through the streams and forests around the lodge. Spot dolphins, caimans, monkeys, macaws, and hundreds of bird species.
toursList.longDesc: The Amazonian Safari is the most complete experience offered by Amazon Samaúma Lodge. Aboard a quiet boat, we navigate the streams and lakes surrounding the lodge, diving into the richest ecosystem on the planet. Our native guides know every curve of the river, every bird that sings in the canopy, every trace left by the fauna living on the Mamori River banks. It's a living classroom with forest walls and a river floor.

toursList.title: Forest Trails
toursList.subtitle: Guided Hikes
toursList.desc: Explore trails through the primary forest with different difficulty levels. Our guides introduce medicinal plants, ancient trees, and jungle secrets.
toursList.longDesc: Walk through the primary Amazon forest accompanied by guides who were born and raised on this land. The trails cross different environments: capoeiras, igapós, dry land, and stream edges. At each stop, you learn about giant trees, vines, medicinal plants used by riverside communities for centuries, and animals that camouflage among the leaves. A unique sensory experience — the smell of the humid forest, the sound of birds, the texture of moss.
highlights: 🌿 Medicinal plants and their traditional uses
📍 Multiple levels: easy, medium, and challenging

toursList.title: Sunset on the River
toursList.subtitle: Boat Ride
toursList.desc: One of the most special moments at the lodge. Go out by boat in the late afternoon and contemplate the sunset over the Mamori River in all its glory.
toursList.longDesc: At 5 PM, the Mamori River turns into a golden mirror. The Amazonian sun slowly dives behind the tree canopies, dyeing the sky red, orange, and violet — colors that exist nowhere else in the world. We head out by boat in small groups, navigate to the open parts of the river, and simply stop the engine. Silence. Nature. A sunset that will remain in your memory forever.
highlights: 🌅 Panoramic view of the Mamori River
🍹 Drinks and snacks on board (on request)
🌙 Return at dusk with a starry sky

toursList.title: Nocturnal Expedition
toursList.subtitle: Alligators & Night Fauna
toursList.desc: For adventurers: night boat outings for alligator spotting and night fishing. Intense, safe, and guided by local specialists.
toursList.longDesc: The Amazon forest at night is a completely different world. Equipped with flashlights and guided by professionals who know every inch of the river, we go out after dinner to discover Mamori's nightlife. Alligators' eyes glow red under the flashlight, potoos sing their characteristic sound, giant otters sleep on the banks. For those who dare to sit at the boat's bow and peer into the dark — this is the most visceral Amazon experience.
highlights: ⭐ Sky with the visible Milky Way

toursList.title: Riverside Culture
toursList.subtitle: Local Communities
toursList.desc: Visit Mamori River communities and get a close look at the culture, traditions, and lifestyle of the Amazonian people.
toursList.longDesc: The Mamori River communities live as they have for centuries — on artisanal fishing, sustainable forest extraction, and oral culture passed down through generations. We visit partner communities, where residents welcome us with cassava flour, tucupi, and stories. You learn to make manioc flour, hear jungle legends, and understand how Amazonians live in harmony with the world's largest river. A deep, life-changing human encounter.

toursList.title: Customized Itinerary
toursList.subtitle: Tailor-Made Experience
toursList.desc: Build your adventure itinerary according to your interests, fitness level, and length of stay.
toursList.longDesc: Every traveler is unique. With this in mind, Amazon Samaúma Lodge offers the possibility of planning a fully customized itinerary — combining boat rides, trekking, fishing, cultural visits, and moments of contemplation, matching your profile, available time, and interests. Whether for a honeymoon, a group trip, an extreme adventure, or a restful retreat — our guides will create the perfect experience for you.
highlights: 👨‍👩‍👧 Ideal for families, couples, and groups

fishing.title: Sport Fishing in the Amazon | Amazon Samaúma Lodge
fishing.description: Sport fishing in the Mamori River — Peacock Bass, Tambaqui, and more. Experienced guides, equipped boats, Catch & Release. Season: Sep–Jan. Careiro Castanho – AM.
fishing.heroDesc: The thrill of fishing in the most preserved rivers of the Amazon, guided by experts.
fishing.introP1: The Amazon is one of the best sport fishing destinations in the world. At the lodge, we offer guided trips on the Mamori River to catch the legendary Tucunaré Açu — the Peacock Bass — alongside other typical regional species.
fishing.introP2: Our owner is also an experienced guide, ensuring a safe, fun, and unforgettable experience. The Catch & Release system guarantees the preservation of species for future generations.
